context.transcript:
All right, let's start our staff meeting.
I met with the executive board yesterday, and after a lot of consideration, they've decided to move our branch of Somerton Bank to a busier area of town in the spring.
Our branch has been struggling for quite a while to attract new customers.
Our location on the edge of town is just too far away from people's homes and jobs.
We're not moving until spring, but we want to get the information out now.
Flyers will be mailed to all of our current customers to announce the change, but we'll also need you to hand them out to customers when they come in.
context.transcript_translation:
好的，让我们开始员工会议。
我昨天和执行董事会开过会，经过一番考虑，他们决定在春天将我们 Somerton Bank 的分行搬到一个更繁忙的市中心区域。
我们的分行长期以来一直难以吸引新客户。
我们位于城郊的位置离人们的家和工作地点太远了。
我们不会直到春天才搬，但现在想把信息传出去。
我们将向所有现有客户邮寄传单来宣布这一变化，但我们也需要您在顾客来店时分发它们。
